verdict: A faithful, well-lit draft with one invented beat, one overloaded shot and a flat discovery; fix those and it is ready.

issues.problem: s1-2 → s1-3 are two medium shots of Layla in a row; the discovery of the falling star has no image of its own.
issues.fix: Make s1-3 a POV shot (35mm) of the star streaking down behind the far hills; Layla's reaction lives in the narration.

issues.problem: 'وتذكّرت تحذيرَ جدّتِها من الذئاب' invents a grandmother and wolves that are not in the story.
issues.fix: Cut the clause; narration becomes 'ومشيا طويلاً بين الأشجارِ الصامتة.'

issues.problem: 29 words in a 4 s shot (7.3 words/s) and 'وإن الليلَ طويلٌ والبردَ شديد' is invented.
issues.fix: Split: s2-3 keeps 'حتى وجدا النجمةَ الصغيرةَ تبكي بين الصخور.'; add an over-shoulder shot past Layla onto the star for 'قالت النجمةُ إنها فقدت طريقَها إلى السماء.'; cut the invented line.

issues.problem: The coda is crammed into the star's flight; the film never returns to the rooftop that opened it.
issues.fix: Split: s3-2 the star flies up (motion 2); a new last scene on the rooftop echoes s1-1, Layla looking at the one brighter star.

issues.problem: The hills look names no time of day or light, so shots there may be painted in daylight.
issues.fix: Append 'late night, cool silver moonlight from the upper right, long blue shadows'.
